name: @bhsd/lezer-abusefilter
description: Lezer parser for MediaWiki extension AbuseFilter
author: Bhsd

scripts.build:analyzer: esbuild analyzer/index.ts --charset=utf8 --target=es2024 --bundle --format=esm --outfile=analyzer/analyzer.js && gsed -i '/^\/\/ /d' analyzer/analyzer.js && cp analyzer/analyzer.js build/ && eslint --no-config-lookup -c eslint.dist.js --no-inline-config analyzer/analyzer.js
scripts.build:core: tsc && cp src/parser.*js dist/ && eslint --no-config-lookup -c eslint.dist.js --no-inline-config dist/*.js
scripts.build: npm run build:parser && npm run build:analyzer && npm run build:core
scripts.lint:ts: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p analyzer/tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && eslint --cache .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:md
scripts.test: rm -rf test/dist/; tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && testUtil test/dist/test.js test/dist/*.test.js
